Report a Case

Your report is received by GFDI's team privately. You do not need to provide your name.

If you or someone else is in immediate danger, do not wait. Call emergency services or see our Emergency Resources page for hotline numbers. Come back here once you are safe.
Confidentiality: All reports are reviewed only by GFDI's activists and legal team. Your submission is handled privately and will not be shared with any third party without your explicit consent. Anonymous reports are fully accepted and will be reviewed.

Report Received

Thank you for trusting GFDI with this report. A member of our team will review it and, if you provided contact details, we will reach out. If you are in a safe situation, please also check our resources page for additional support.

The fields below are entirely optional. You may submit this report without providing any contact information.

Submitted reports go directly and securely to GFDI's team. They are never posted publicly.
